exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: HOLD 75kg. You've hit a clean 3x8 @ RPE 9 twice in a row (07-09 and 07-23). RPE 9 on a main lift is exactly the target zone, so no reason to move it - but no reason to add weight either while overall fatigue is elevated. Retention is the goal on a cut.

exercises.name: Pull-Up Parallel Close Grip
exercises.notes: Target trimmed 6 -> 5. You did 4x6 @ RPE 10 on 07-09, then 4x5 @ RPE 9 on 07-23. The 5-rep version is the one that lands in the right effort zone. Hit 4 clean sets of 5; if the last set feels like RPE 7-8, say so in the notes and we go back up next time.

exercises.name: Machine Seated Row
exercises.notes: HOLD 20kg, reps 10 -> 12. This is the only Day B lift with real headroom: after the deload from 25kg you did 3x10 @ RPE 8 (vs 10/10/8 @ RPE 10 at 25kg). Progress via reps first - earn 3x12 here and 22.5kg comes back next session.

exercises.name: EZ Bar Curl
exercises.notes: HOLD 30kg, reps trimmed 12 -> 10. You've completed 3x12 @ RPE 10 twice running. Completed but maxed - an accessory should sit at RPE 7-8 during a cut, especially with a to-failure preacher drop set still coming at the end.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.notes: UP to 42.5kg (from 40). 3x15 @ RPE 7 last time - the one lift in the program with clear room, so it earns the 2.5kg. If the stack only steps in 5kg, take 45kg and drop to 12 reps. Keep this one strict: it's doing lower-back / posture work, not chasing load.

exercises.name: Box Situp
exercises.notes: Target trimmed 15 -> 10. You got 3x10 @ RPE 9 last time against a 15 target, so 10 is the honest number. LOWER BACK: controlled backward extension over the box, no ballistic hyperextension - this slot exists because Ab Wheel aggravated your back.

exercises.name: Machine Preacher Curl (drop set)
exercises.notes: ONE triple-drop, no rest between drops: 30kg to failure -> 25kg to failure -> 20kg to failure. Weights hold. RPE 10 here is by design, so I'm not deloading it - but note your first drop fell 12 reps (07-09) to 8 reps (07-23) at the same weight. If it lands at 8 or below again, that's a systemic recovery signal, not a bicep problem.

session_notes: Two things to know today. (1) Every weight holds except Face Pull, and three rep targets are trimmed (pull-up 6->5, EZ curl 12->10, box situp 15->10) to pull effort back into the RPE 8-9 main / 7-8 accessory zone. This continues the de-load posture from 07-28, because the clean fatigue read on Day B lifts (07-23: RPE 9-10 on 5 of 7) still says fatigue, not weakness. (2) The 07-28 session was at a different gym and those numbers are NOT comparable - bench logged 40kg against a 70kg target. If you're at that gym again, treat the three machine targets (Seated Row, Face Pull, Preacher Curl) as effort references only: match the target REPS at whatever weight puts you in the right RPE, and log the actual weight so I can build a separate baseline for that gym. Barbell and bodyweight work (RDL, pull-ups, EZ curl) transfers unchanged.
